is Concretization Of

Property

The relation that obtains between a concrete particular c and a schematic particular s if and only if (1) c exemplifies or has the main features of s, and (2) s provides the benchmark or the norm for the properties and the behaviour of c

Note

The concretizations of a schematic particular can deviate from it in various respects: for example, most performances of Beethoven's Symphony No 9 typically lasts between 65 and 75 minutes, but the 2018 performance from the Philarmonia Orchestra conducted by Benjamin Zander only lasts 58 minutes; in some cases, the deviation is merely an anomaly, but in other cases it entails that the concretization is defective, faulty, or bad, like a poorly made Sachertorte, or a faulty Toyota Corolla unit

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
